answer: Here is a specific defense: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The nectar of work and the dawn of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a walnut to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
